# Hero color reference table

Source: [8507](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/8507); edited 2026-03-17. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-8507-n1"></a>

- Hero RGB/HEX catalog includes an RGBA array intended to match All Heroes ordering and lookup by Index Of Array Value(All Heroes, Hero Of(player)); array order is an external dependency that must be maintained.

<a id="wiki-8507-n2"></a>

- Table and copyable array disagree: Hanzo green is 179 in array versus 180 in table; Symmetra red 45 versus 145; Mei red 09 versus 109.

<a id="wiki-8507-n3"></a>

- Copyable array stops at Vendetta while table continues with Domina, Emre, Anran, Mizuki and Jetpack Cat; direct positional lookup lacks those entries.

<a id="wiki-8507-n4"></a>

- Catalog source explicitly requests updates when heroes release, so it is maintained empirical presentation data rather than a stable engine constant.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/8507.md).

Source limitations:

- March 2026 metadata does not guarantee All Heroes order or hero coverage matches current target.

- Discrepancies must be resolved before generating a canonical array; prefer named records until positional ordering is validated.

- Styling's final hero row colors also do not consistently track displayed order; CSS is not an authoritative data source.
